description: A stereo clipper whose corner can be made hard or soft, with a ladder of lamps showing where the clipping starts and how loud the signal is

params.text: Chooses the voltage the clipper works against, 5V in the lower position and 10V in the upper
Crossfades between the untouched input and the clipped signal, dry at the far left and fully clipped at the far right
Bends the clipping threshold towards a 150Hz-smoothed reading of the input level, so a quiet passage clips lower; none at the far left, and the result is held between 0.1V and 10V
Sets the shape of the corner, from a soft rounded bend at the far left to an almost square corner at the far right

inputs.text: The left input, and the source for the right channel as well when the right jack is empty

notes: A polyphonic cable is summed to one channel at each input, and both outputs send a single channel

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
